🚀 bentopdf | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing a secure, self-hostable, and feature-rich PDF toolkit that operates entirely within the user's browser, enhancing privacy and control over document processing.
✨ Key Features: • Client-side PDF manipulation • Self-hostable • Privacy-first design (no server-side processing) • Comprehensive PDF tools (edit, merge, convert, secure, optimize) • Docker support for easy deployment
📖 Summary: BentoPDF is a privacy-focused, client-side JavaScript toolkit for manipulating PDF files directly in the browser. It offers a wide range of PDF processing tools without requiring server-side interaction, making it ideal for self-hosting and ensuring data privacy.
